proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.trigger.touch_item / end_of_turn_holding_or_carrying
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's passive damage rider needs event-driven item-contact and item-possession triggers, not elapsed-time cadence.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

proposed_widenings.name: destroy_target
proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke destroys the target outright on a failed save; no existing effect atom honestly models deterministic destruction with no remains.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains.

proposed_widenings.name: save_gate target-type disadvantage rider
proposed_widenings.justification: The save penalty applies only when the save target is a Fiend or an Undead. Existing save/advantage shapes do not express that conditional modifier honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has Disadvantage on the save.

notes: No content file was authored. The item's magic-item/composite envelope exists, but the missing contact-trigger grammar and destroy-on-fail effect are central enough that a partial encoding would misrepresent the unit.
